turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account. Ticket: 'My invoice shows the wrong VAT amount.' Answer with the label only.

For your records, our queue convention: tickets about exports, downloads, or file access are handled as account, because they trace back to permissions; payment, invoice, and charge problems are billing; crashes, freezes, and wrong outputs are bug. Acknowledge in one line.
